name: Log & Telemetry Collection
description: Log and telemetry collection — also called log shipping, metrics/trace ingestion, the telemetry pipeline, or agent-to-SIEM flow — the flow of events and metrics from components into the monitoring and SIEM tier. The feed that detection depends on. The place to look for log shipping, telemetry/metrics ingestion, the observability pipeline, or how events reach the monitoring stack.
